name: Ruby Chamber & Sapphire Trench
summary: Awaken the primordial land and sea titans across the Sevii archipelago. First, purchase heat-protection cream from the Cinnabar Island Mart and scale Mt. Ember on Knot Island to explore the subterranean Ruby Chamber. Follow the magma tunnels (Right to Left to Right) to locate and battle Groudon (Lv. 60). Next, surf south of Brine Road to the deep ocean trench, utilizing Scuba Gear to Dive into the depths and illuminate the submerged Sapphire Cave with Flash. Navigate the oceanic chasms to find Kyogre (Lv. 60). Subdue and capture both titans to fulfill the ancient prerequisite for the Sky Pillar.

items.name: Red Orb
items.method: Found embedded in the magma wall directly behind Groudon in the Ruby Chamber

items.name: Blue Orb
items.method: Found resting on the ancient coral dais behind Kyogre in the Sapphire Cave

items.name: Fire Gem
items.method: Found in an elevated volcanic alcove within the Ruby Chamber
